acceptDefaultAdminTransfer().details: Completes a {defaultAdmin} transfer previously started with {beginDefaultAdminTransfer}. After calling the function: - `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` should be granted to the caller. - `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` should be revoked from the previous holder. - {pendingDefaultAdmin} should be reset to zero values. Requirements: - Only can be called by the {pendingDefaultAdmin}'s `newAdmin`. - The {pendingDefaultAdmin}'s `acceptSchedule` should've passed.

beginDefaultAdminTransfer(address).details: Starts a {defaultAdmin} transfer by setting a {pendingDefaultAdmin} scheduled for acceptance after the current timestamp plus a {defaultAdminDelay}. Requirements: - Only can be called by the current {defaultAdmin}. Emits a {DefaultAdminTransferScheduled} event.

params.amount: Raw USDC salary amount, excluding fees.

returns.fee: Protocol fee, rounded down to a base unit.

cancelDefaultAdminTransfer().details: Cancels a {defaultAdmin} transfer previously started with {beginDefaultAdminTransfer}. A {pendingDefaultAdmin} not yet accepted can also be cancelled with this function. Requirements: - Only can be called by the current {defaultAdmin}. May emit a {DefaultAdminTransferCanceled} event.

params.payrollId: Identifier of the draft to cancel.

changeDefaultAdminDelay(uint48).details: Initiates a {defaultAdminDelay} update by setting a {pendingDefaultAdminDelay} scheduled for getting into effect after the current timestamp plus a {defaultAdminDelay}. This function guarantees that any call to {beginDefaultAdminTransfer} done between the timestamp this method is called and the {pendingDefaultAdminDelay} effect schedule will use the current {defaultAdminDelay} set before calling. The {pendingDefaultAdminDelay}'s effect schedule is defined in a way that waiting until the schedule and then calling {beginDefaultAdminTransfer} with the new delay will take at least the same as another {defaultAdmin} complete transfer (including acceptance). The schedule is designed for two scenarios: - When the delay is changed for a larger one the schedule is `block.timestamp + newDelay` capped by {defaultAdminDelayIncreaseWait}. - When the delay is changed for a shorter one, the schedule is `block.timestamp + (current delay - new delay)`. A {pendingDefaultAdminDelay} that never got into effect will be canceled in favor of a new scheduled change. Requirements: - Only can be called by the current {defaultAdmin}. Emits a {DefaultAdminDelayChangeScheduled} event and may emit a {DefaultAdminDelayChangeCanceled} event.

params.payrollId: Funded payroll containing the caller's unpaid allocation.

claimSalary().details: Call repeatedly when more than 50 allocations remain; expiry does not block claims.

params.employee: Nonzero employee whose open allocations should be claimed, up to 50.

params.admin: Initial administrator; receives PAUSER_ROLE but not HR or Finance.
params.adminDelay: Delay in seconds for default-administrator handover.
params.feeBps_: Initial protocol fee in basis points, capped at 500.

params.amounts: Nonzero salaries in raw USDC units, parallel to employees.
params.deadline: Future expiry timestamp for Finance refunds.
params.employees: Distinct nonzero salary recipients, capped at 200.
params.payrollId: Unique nonzero identifier, never reusable even after cancellation.
params.totalAmount: Expected sum of all salaries, excluding fees.

defaultAdmin().details: Returns the address of the current `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` holder.

defaultAdminDelay().details: Returns the delay required to schedule the acceptance of a {defaultAdmin} transfer started. This delay will be added to the current timestamp when calling {beginDefaultAdminTransfer} to set the acceptance schedule. NOTE: If a delay change has been scheduled, it will take effect as soon as the schedule passes, making this function returns the new delay. See {changeDefaultAdminDelay}.

defaultAdminDelayIncreaseWait().details: Maximum time in seconds for an increase to {defaultAdminDelay} (that is scheduled using {changeDefaultAdminDelay}) to take effect. Default to 5 days. When the {defaultAdminDelay} is scheduled to be increased, it goes into effect after the new delay has passed with the purpose of giving enough time for reverting any accidental change (i.e. using milliseconds instead of seconds) that may lock the contract. However, to avoid excessive schedules, the wait is capped by this function and it can be overridden for a custom {defaultAdminDelay} increase scheduling. IMPORTANT: Make sure to add a reasonable amount of time while overriding this value, otherwise, there's a risk of setting a high new delay that goes into effect almost immediately without the possibility of human intervention in the case of an input error (eg. set milliseconds instead of seconds).

fundPayroll(bytes32).details: Pulls USDC from msg.sender (the Finance wallet). Finance should approve the vault only for the exact reviewed total+fee; the allowance is the natural bound if the fee changes before funding. Refunds go to the wallet that funded the payroll.

params.payrollId: Identifier of the draft to fund.

fundPayrollDirect(bytes32,uint64,address.details: Subject to the same `requireSeparateApprover` policy as `fundPayroll`: when the admin enables it, this atomic path reverts because the caller would approve its own payroll.

params.amounts: Nonzero raw USDC salaries parallel to employees.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

getRoleMembers(bytes32,uint256,uint256).details: Set ordering is unstable after removals; use a fixed block when reading multiple pages.

params.limit: Maximum members to return, capped at 100 and the remaining set length.
params.offset: Zero-based starting index in the role member set.

returns.members: Role members, or an empty array when offset is out of range.

returns._0: Whether the account holds the role.

owner().details: Gets the address of the owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingDefaultAdmin().details: Returns a tuple of a `newAdmin` and an accept schedule. After the `schedule` passes, the `newAdmin` will be able to accept the {defaultAdmin} role by calling {acceptDefaultAdminTransfer}, completing the role transfer. A zero value only in `acceptSchedule` indicates no pending admin transfer. NOTE: A zero address `newAdmin` means that {defaultAdmin} is being renounced.

pendingDefaultAdminDelay().details: Returns a tuple of `newDelay` and an effect schedule. After the `schedule` passes, the `newDelay` will get into effect immediately for every new {defaultAdmin} transfer started with {beginDefaultAdminTransfer}. A zero value only in `effectSchedule` indicates no pending delay change. NOTE: A zero value only for `newDelay` means that the next {defaultAdminDelay} will be zero after the effect schedule.

params.employee: Employee whose unpaid allocation should be refunded.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: See {AccessControl-renounceRole}. For the `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, it only allows renouncing in two steps by first calling {beginDefaultAdminTransfer} to the `address(0)`, so it's required that the {pendingDefaultAdmin} schedule has also passed when calling this function. After its execution, it will not be possible to call `onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)` functions. NOTE: Renouncing `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` will leave the contract without a {defaultAdmin}, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available for it, and the possibility of reassigning a non-administrated role.

rescueToken(address,address,uint256).details: Available while paused. If USDC is undercollateralized, no USDC rescue is possible.

params.amount: Nonzero amount in the token's base units.

returns._0: Number of accounts holding the role.

rollbackDefaultAdminDelay().details: Cancels a scheduled {defaultAdminDelay} change. Requirements: - Only can be called by the current {defaultAdmin}. May emit a {DefaultAdminDelayChangeCanceled} event.

params.required: Whether the funding account must differ from the draft creator.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

FINANCE_ROLE().notice: Role permitted to fund payrolls and refund expired allocations.

MAX_CLAIM_BATCH().notice: Maximum payroll allocations processed by an aggregate claim.

MAX_FEE_BPS().notice: Maximum protocol fee in basis points (5%).

PAUSER_ROLE().notice: Role permitted to pause and unpause operations.

RELAYER_ROLE().notice: Role permitted to trigger claims on behalf of employees.

allocations(bytes32,address).notice: Salary allocations by payroll and employee.

calculateFee(uint256).notice: Quotes the current funding fee and inclusive charge for a salary amount.

cancelPayrollDraft(bytes32).notice: Cancels an existing draft; allowed while paused and restricted to HR or Finance.

claimPayrollSalary(bytes32).notice: Claims the caller's allocation from a single payroll, including after expiry.

claimSalary().notice: Claims up to 50 open payroll allocations to the caller's own wallet.

claimSalaryFor(address).notice: Lets an employee or an authorized relayer trigger a payment only to that employee.

claimableBalance(address).notice: Total unclaimed, unrefunded funded salary for each employee.

constructor.notice: Initializes the fixed token, delayed administrator, pauser, and fee configuration.

createPayrollDraft(bytes32,uint64,addres.notice: Creates an immutable draft without moving tokens or crediting claimable balances.

feeBps().notice: Fee rate applied to future funding, in basis points.

feeRecipient().notice: Recipient of fees on future funding.

fundPayroll(bytes32).notice: Funds a draft from the Finance caller; separate approval is off by default. By default Finance may fund any draft, including one it prepared itself. The admin can enable requireSeparateApprover so a Finance account other than the draft creator must fund each draft through this function.

fundPayrollDirect(bytes32,uint64,address.notice: Creates and funds a payroll atomically, exclusively for deliberately dual-role accounts.

getAllocation(bytes32,address).notice: Returns an allocation, or a zero-initialized struct if absent.

getClaimableBalance(address).notice: Returns all funded salary still claimable by an employee, across all batches.

getOpenPayrollIds(address,uint256,uint25.notice: Returns a page of an employee's funded allocations awaiting claim or refund.

getPayroll(bytes32).notice: Returns payroll metadata; an unknown identifier returns exists == false.

getPayrollEmployees(bytes32).notice: Returns the original ordered employee list, including for settled or cancelled payrolls.

getPayrollIds(uint256,uint256).notice: Returns a page of all payroll identifiers in creation order.

getRoleMembers(bytes32,uint256,uint256).notice: Returns a page of current members of a role, including DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

isRoleMember(bytes32,address).notice: Tests membership in a role, including DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

openPayrollCount(address).notice: Returns the number of funded allocations awaiting claim or refund for an employee.

pause().notice: Pauses drafting, funding, refunds, and claims.

payrollCount().notice: Returns the number of payrolls ever created, including cancelled and settled payrolls.

refundLeftover(bytes32,address).notice: Refunds one expired, unpaid allocation to its original funding wallet.

requireSeparateApprover().notice: Whether standard draft funding requires a Finance account other than its creator; off by default.

rescueToken(address,address,uint256).notice: Rescues unrelated ERC-20 tokens or USDC surplus, never escrowed salary.

roleMemberCount(bytes32).notice: Returns the number of current members of a role, including DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

setProtocolFee(uint256,address).notice: Updates the fee rate and recipient for future funding only.

setRequireSeparateApprover(bool).notice: Sets whether standard draft funding requires a separate Finance approver.

totalClaimed(address).notice: Cumulative salary paid to each employee.

totalEscrowed().notice: Sum of remainingEscrow across all FUNDED payrolls.

totalProtocolFeesCollected().notice: Cumulative fees forwarded to fee recipients.

unpause().notice: Resumes drafting, funding, refunds, and claims.
